title: Construct exact optima and dual bounds for bounded parameter models
body:
Add an exact optimizer for small bounded linear parameter models with a checked feasible incumbent. It constructs both an optimal point and nonnegative dual multipliers. The separate checker proves primal feasibility and equality with the dual upper bound without enumerating vertices. This complements PR5767 certificate checking while remaining independent of that pending PR.

Six tests pass normally and under -O on CPython 3.12.14: 100 two-dimensional models against an independent line-intersection oracle, a fractional triangle optimum, degenerate boxes and zero objectives, six parameters, malformed or infeasible incumbents, excessive search declarations, forged primal/dual receipts and portable input-hash replay.

The guide proves finite enumeration coverage and explains strict-margin modeling. Limits: six parameters, 24 total rows including box bounds, at most 50000 active bases and input rational numerator/denominator magnitudes through 10^9. The supplied incumbent must be feasible; rejecting it is not an infeasibility claim. Nonlinear constraints, integer/rounded parameters and source-to-row correctness remain outside this model. Classical LP duality and vertex theory retain their credit. No kappa or frontier change.

Fresh upstream, priorities and overlap checked at both checkpoints. Canonical scope https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5776. Hosted CI and independent review remain pending.

Base: `de5ec2e7a6074068452f45b1a191b5c72832df4a`. Verified head: `06d748d09adb29b1bf2d8a8911320e6ca4a915e3`.

Prepared for Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Retained tool and mathematical predecessor credits apply. No selected-frontier change.
